SWARM_DEMO.description: Set to 1 for deterministic mock replies with a seeded #general thread (no provider keys needed). Set to 0 once you have added a real provider key.

SWARM_AGENT_MODEL.description: Model override applied to every agent, e.g. openai/gpt-oss-120b (Groq) or a model slug from your provider.

GROQ_API_KEY.description: Groq API key so bots can respond (free tier at console.groq.com). Replace the placeholder with your key, or leave and manage keys in the UI under Command Center → AI providers.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: OpenRouter key used as fallback provider if Groq fails or is unset. Manageable in the UI as well.

SWARM_SECRET.description: Secret used for signing sessions. Auto-generated placeholder; each install gets a unique value.

SWARM_BROWSER.description: 1 enables Playwright browser-use tools for bots; set 0 to disable.

SWARM_SYSTEM.description: 1 lets bots run tools on the host (system_run/read/write) bound to SWARM_SYSTEM_ROOT; set 0 to disable on untrusted networks.

SWARM_OPENAI_COMPAT_BASE_URL.description: Optional. Base URL of your own OpenAI-compatible server (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM), e.g. http://ollama.railway.internal:11434/v1. Leave empty if not using a custom provider (the Custom provider stays hidden).

SWARM_OPENAI_COMPAT_API_KEY.description: Key for the custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint; blank works for keyless servers.

EXA_API_KEY.description: Exa API key for web research tools (Computer → Apps). Optional.

TAVILY_API_KEY.description: Tavily API key for web research tools (Computer → Apps). Optional.

FIRECRAWL_API_KEY.description: Firecrawl API key for web crawl tools (Computer → Apps). Optional.

COMPOSIO_API_KEY.description: Composio key for app integrations (Gmail, Slack, GitHub, Notion, 1000+ apps). Optional.

COMPOSIO_USER_ID.description: Shared Composio user_id so every bot sees the same connected accounts.

LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Langfuse public key for LLM observability. Optional.

LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY.description: Langfuse secret key for LLM observability. Optional.

LANGFUSE_HOST.description: Langfuse host URL if you use observability. Optional.
